editorial.intro: If you want a spinning setup for bass or lighter inshore work, the Beast 3000H gives you a 10 lb / 140-yard mono reference to plan around. Rocket Line Management helps control line coming off the spool, but the diameter of the line you choose still determines how much fits. Use the calculator below for a full fill or a shorter main line over optional backing.
editorial.who: Abu Garcia designed the Beast family around larger baits and greater cranking and drag demands. Choose this size to suit the rod, presentation and amount of reserve you need; a higher drag rating is not a reason to fish more drag than your line and knots can handle.
editorial.quickAnswer: 10-20 lb braid is ReelCalc's starting suggestion, not a manufacturer limit. A straight-line alternative is 8-10 lb mono/fluoro. Match either choice to your rod and fishing conditions; backing is optional.
editorial.calculatorIntro: This calculator is set to BST3000H. Capacity Only estimates a full spool; Backing + Main Line estimates backing beneath the working length you choose. Both are estimates. A verified retrieve rate is unavailable, so no handle-turn estimate is preloaded.
editorial.setupIntro: Start with the line range that suits your rod and fishing. You can fill with main line or use backing beneath a shorter working length. For braid, secure the base against slipping and spool under steady tension; stop at a sensible clearance below the lip.

editorial.specsIntro: Abu Garcia publishes the ratio, drag, bearing count and capacities below. Reel weight and line retrieve were not published in the checked manufacturer table and are left unconfirmed. This is a specification-based setup guide, not a hands-on review.
editorial.faqBraid: 10-20 lb braid is the practical ReelCalc range for this reel. Use the lighter end for lighter lures in open water. For the reel's inshore or mixed-cover uses, choose more strength when your rod, rig, and the structure call for it. A leader suited to the fish and structure matters too; the braid's pound-test label does not tell you the whole setup.
editorial.faqCapacity: The capacity table shows the manufacturer ratings for BST3000H. Your chosen line may be thicker or thinner than the line behind a pound-test rating. Use its diameter in the calculator and watch the actual fill level rather than trying to force on the last few yards.
